title: Surreal Dream Collage
description: A composite surreal artwork divided into distinct panels. The top section shows a man in a dark coat and red hat standing in a rainy Victorian street, a woman holding a glowing blue umbrella standing on a large black sphere, an orange dragon-like creature, and a vibrant purple abstract space with floating orbs and a butterfly. The bottom section contains red hot air balloons, a green dragon coiled over stylized grey waves, and a detailed branch of yellow flowers against a dark background.
